question: What generative identity is attributed to the goddess in ekāra?
premises: In ekāra is the mother goddess
inference: The goddess in ekāra is Mātṛkā, the mother associated with the arising of the universe.
uncertainties: The compound viśva-utpannā admits multiple readings in relation to origin
plain_english: In ekāra is the mother goddess, indeed the world-born Mātṛkā.
